additional_info.subject: ID0445817-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / P9 170000775] Convertor Error CRM:02678000216
additional_info.body:
Hello Yigit, good afternoon.
Please check the following circuit:
Make sure that the XD10.3 is not loose and you can measure 60Ohm between H and L up until the KF11 when the error is active.
Also, check if the CAN connectors from the converters are fitted properly as well.
There is no much more we can check, otherwise, I would advise you to swap a working converter with a non-working converter to understand if the problem is the cabling or the converter itself.
I will send this ticket back to RC-TR but feel free to reach out to me for support. If you need on-site support please schedule with at least 2 days in advance to prepare.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
